Delicate clean contour lines, sophisticated gouache and colored ink, consistent shallow isometric 3/4 view, believable wooden joinery, muted indigo and mineral teal with soft warm amber lantern lighting, understated cinnabar details. Handcrafted, expressive, cohesive, very fine readable silhouettes. No text, no letters, no numerals, no UI, no borders, no watermark. Portrait 2:3 game background ONLY. Entire central and lower 75% an unobstructed clean stone courtyard, softly illuminated by lanterns only at the outer edges. No stalls, no characters, no grid lines, no props or large objects in the center. Top-down shallow isometric ground plane, flat rectangular composition, dark perimeter vignette. Calm spacious scene, atmospheric but gameplay readability paramount.
